source_message.text:
At this point, 34 mints should correspond to 34 tickets and 34 x $20 commissions.

A mint still produces a ticket and commission even when no referral code is supplied.

Accounting works correctly on the leaderboards and NFT attributes whenever a code is used. That part is perfect.

Without a referral code, the ticket and commission are assigned randomly, but both must still appear on the leaderboard and in the NFT attributes.

Since your latest fix, the randomly assigned tickets from the last 7 mints seem to have been recorded correctly, which is great. The earlier missing tickets have not been backfilled, though.

The $18 commissions generated by these no-code buys are also still missing from the leaderboard and NFT attributes.

My screenshot shows an NFT with 9 tickets but only 4 x $20 commissions. That should be impossible because every ticket comes with a $18 commission.

The leaderboard screenshot accounts for only 15 tickets and 12 x $8 commissions from 34 total mints. Regardless of whether a referral code was supplied, 34 mints should produce 34 tickets and 34 x $20 commissions.
